in_sanskrit.name: Mujamil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Delightful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mujamil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is filled with joy and happiness, like a river overflowing with water, bringing calmness and delight to those around him.

in_hindi.name: Mujamil
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Delightful
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mujamil एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is filled with joy and happiness, like a river overflowing with water, bringing calmness and delight to those around him.

in_tamil.name: Mujamil
in_tamil.long_meaning: Mujamil ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is filled with joy and happiness, like a river overflowing with water, bringing calmness and delight to those around him.

in_telugu.name: Mujamil
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mujamil ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is filled with joy and happiness, like a river overflowing with water, bringing calmness and delight to those around him.

in_marathi.name: Mujamil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mujamil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is filled with joy and happiness, like a river overflowing with water, bringing calmness and delight to those around him.

in_bengali.name: Mujamil
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mujamil একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is filled with joy and happiness, like a river overflowing with water, bringing calmness and delight to those around him.
